what: The handful of people in the street, for Jafar's presentable checklist (ROADMAP.md, 23 September): 'a handful of people stand or walk in the street, even if they only idle'. Each is a glb in production/assets/people made by tools/art-recipes/person-export.py from a Mixamo body and clip already held (D46), imported by tools/ue/import_people.py and placed by the Unreal probe. Street metres as the scene file gives them: x along the street, z across (east is +), y the ground height, the footway's own at that z. face_deg is the direction the person faces, as a yaw in Unreal (0 up the street, 90 toward the east side). phase is where in its loop each starts, so the idles do not move in step. They are seen and not simulated: no collision, no perception, nothing a system reads.

people.why: one of a pair talking on the parade's pavement, as the sheet's two men are, his back half to the camera
the other of the pair, facing him and the camera
standing by a shop window, looking out into the street
across the road on the plain terrace's pavement, facing the parade
further up the west pavement, facing down the street toward the camera
at Mickey's window, turned toward the street's south end: the person in the PS5 corner until a MetaHuman can be made, and near Mickey's front in the hook frame, where the sheet has people too

cast_what: THE SLICE'S CAST AS METAHUMANS, 24 September. Jafar: 'MetaHumans replace the Mixamo stand-ins for the slice's cast, starting with Rocco, Lena and Sam, in plain clothes for now.' In the playable street each takes the place and facing of the stand-in it replaces; the automation's shots keep the stand-ins, so the street's comparison frames do not move. Made by tools/ue/make_cast_metahumans.py from the plugin's presets (Rocco from Jorge, Lena from Grace, Sam from Orlando), outside the repository; the idle is the one retargeted onto MH_Test, played on any part that shares its skeleton.

cast.why: at Mickey's door, where the bookkeeper steps out
one of the pair talking on the parade's pavement: at noon his routine has him at the fish front
the other of the pair: Sam is at the fish front from nine to one
